evidence: Changes C API implementation in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, headers in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and kernel tests in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a critical boundary correctness bug where validating a block under one set of parameters mutates internal flags (`fChecked`) and causes subsequent checks under different parameters to falsely pass. The description notes that on master, a regtest block checked once allows `btck_block_check` with mainnet params to return 1, and connecting across different signet challenges causes chains to fail reading back their own tips.
